release: CoreSpirit v90 — small language surface, first-class composability, and backend-transparent execution

language_surface: six-concept authoring surface preserved: DATA, LET, WHEN, SHOW, MODEL, AUTOMATE
component calls compose through ordinary LET expressions
composability: typed component contracts with callable aliases
single-output components behave as normal typed values
multi-output components behave as typed component references with member access
component metadata carried into stable IR calls
component-aware execution graph and reactive invalidation metadata
incremental compiler/cache identity includes component contracts
runtime: VM component execution boundary with host-supplied executors
component statefulness/determinism metadata preserved for scheduling and caching
no broker or unrestricted host authority granted by component registration

not_claimed: Full production Vite build in a fully installed dependency environment; the provided environment had an incomplete node_modules install and missing vite/client declarations.
User-authored function syntax or arbitrary higher-order functions; reusable composition is supplied through typed registered components and the existing semantic graph.
Production GPU/WASM component backends; backend planning remains an execution-host concern.
Automatic arbitrary component discovery from untrusted packages; registration remains an explicit host boundary.
